{{italic title}}
'''''Logic Made Easy: How to Know When Language Deceives You''''' is a 2004 book by [[Deborah J. Bennett]] published by [[W.W. Norton & Company]] ({{ISBN|0-393-05748-8}}).  Its theme is the analysis of what common words such as "some", "all", and "not" mean, and how logic relates to speech and writing.  It discusses eliminating problems such as [[ambiguity]] and [[imprecise language]] from [[communication]]s, such as in [[technical writing]].
